en: Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor included [within the mundane], a state that is indeterminate and included arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor included, a state that is indeterminate and included arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither indeterminate nor included, a state that is indeterminate and included arises.
By way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Five [conditions] in the case of root; five in the case of predominance …pe… three in the case of result …pe… five in the case of non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor included [in the mundane], a wholesome state not included [in the mundane] arises by way of root-condition.
Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor included [in the mundane], an indeterminate state not included [in the mundane] arises.

Conditioned by root-cause ... two. (Two in the case of unwholesome roots; two in the case of the pair of roots. Under root-cause condition there are six; under resultant condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.
